subject: Vendor registration + PO requirements for BlueHarbor — next steps
messages:
From: Elise Moreno <elise.moreno@blueharbor-corp.com>
To: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: ap@blueharbor-corp.com
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding — next steps & PO requirements

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the demo last week — we are ready to register Redwood Inference as a supplier in our AP system. Two requests from procurement to get started:

1) Portal enrollment link for vendor self-service (we prefer vendor-completed forms)
2) A consolidated vendor packet (W‑9 / VAT certificate, legal entity name, DBA, registered address, TIN/EIN, and bank remittance instructions)
3) Confirmation of how Redwood wants PO numbers to appear on invoices and whether we should include VAT on the invoice or treat it as zero-rated (this is for our AP mapping)

I've attached our vendor onboarding instructions and a sample PO layout — our AP team needs the PO number in the <OrderRef> XML tag and the remit currency flagged (USD/EUR).

Can you confirm who will submit the packet and whether Redwood can accept ACH and wire for initial invoices?

Thanks,

Elise
Elise Moreno
Senior Procurement Manager | BlueHarbor Corporation
Attachment: blueharbor_vendor_instructions.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: sample_po.xml (text/xml)
From: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Elise Moreno <elise.moreno@blueharbor-corp.com>
Cc: naomi.feldman@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — next steps & PO requirements

Hi Elise — thanks, and great to kick this over.

Quick answers up front:
- We can accept ACH and wire; we'll provide bank account details in the vendor packet.
- Please put the customer's PO number in the OrderRef tag as in your sample. We also ask that the PO number appear in the invoice PDF filename and the invoice body (top-right) for faster matching.
- For VAT: Redwood will invoice net of VAT for US sales. For EU invoices, we need the buyer's VAT ID to decide whether to apply reverse-charge. If BlueHarbor intends to self-account, please send the VAT ID that should appear on our invoices.

I'll loop in Naomi from Finance to prepare the vendor packet and the signed bank letter. Naomi — can you review the attached sample and confirm we can complete the BlueHarbor portal form, or would you prefer them to self-submit? Also please prepare a redwood_vendor_packet.pdf with the W‑9 and bank_letter_redwood.pdf to attach back.

Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Vendor Portal <vendors@blueharbor-corp.com>
To: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Vendor onboarding — portal link and required fields

Hi Vivek,

Portal link: https://portal.blueharbor-corp.com/vendor/registration/7a4b

Required fields for automatic onboarding:
- Legal name
- Tax ID (TIN/VAT)
- Registered address
- Remit account: account number + SWIFT/IBAN (if outside US)
- Invoice remit currency
- W‑9 for US entities or VAT registration certificate for EU entities

You can either (A) complete the portal using the primary vendor email (we'll send a verification link) or (B) upload a consolidated packet through the portal under "Upload Documents". If you upload, make sure the filename includes your Redwood vendor ID (suggested format: REDWOOD-<EIN>-packet.pdf) so our matching automations work.

Our AP team will validate within 3 business days once docs are uploaded. If they flag anything we'll open a ticket to ap@blueharbor-corp.com.

Regards,
BlueHarbor Vendor Support
Attachment: vendor_portal_instructions.pdf (application/pdf)
From: naomi.feldman@redwood.com <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Elise Moreno <elise.moreno@blueharbor-corp.com>
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — packet submitted (REDWOOD-EIN-12345)

Hi Elise,

Thanks — we completed the portal enrollment and uploaded the consolidated vendor packet as requested. Summary below and attachments included.

What we uploaded:
- redwood_vendor_packet.pdf (W‑9, certificate of incorporation, legal entity + DBA)
- bank_letter_redwood.pdf (signed letter from bank with account and routing details)
- supplemental_tax_info.txt (notes: US invoices net of VAT; for EU entities we will include buyer VAT ID on invoice to trigger reverse-charge)

Invoice/PO guidance for your AP team:
- Put PO number in the XML <OrderRef> tag and in the invoice PDF header (top-right).
- Filename format: invoice_REDWOOD_<PO#>_<YYYYMMDD>.pdf
- Preferred remit currency: USD (we can invoice EUR if requested; include currency on PO)
- Payment terms: Net 45 by default for enterprise agreements; if you'd like Net30 please confirm term exception in writing.

Next steps: please confirm receipt/validation when the portal shows status "Validated". If BlueHarbor requires a Net30 term or early-pay discount, loop in your buyer and let us know the buyer contact and PO reference.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_vendor_packet.pdf, bank_letter_redwood.pdf
